text:
sara: FYI customer reported a sudden uptick in 503s hitting /v1/generate around 13:04 UTC. ~18% error rate over last 10m, p95 latency jumped from 420ms -> 1.8s. sample request id: rq_3f8b2c. They say it started right after a traffic spike from a batch job.

alex: can you paste the raw error headers or a curl repro? which region?

sara: customer is US-West (usw2). they ran a quick curl loop and attached output:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hi"}' & done
```
then after ~25s many responses returned 503 with headers: `x-rw-proxy-status: 503`, `x-rw-upstream-latency: 1200ms`, `x-rw-retryable: true`.

support-bot: alert: proxy_pool_high_5xx_rate triggered for cluster usw2-proxy-7 (threshold 10%)

matt: looks like the ingress proxy pool started shedding connections under burst. suspect the new shaper config we rolled last week (burst_elevator) kicked in. can someone grab proxy logs for rq_3f8b2c and any neighbor req ids?

alex: @infra-oncall can you check why burst_elevator started tripping? any config drift or autoscale lag?

infra-oncall: pulling logs now. quick note — autoscaler did not spin extra proxy pods for 2m due to a metric tagging mismatch (we missed tags from the region label after the infra deploy). investigating rollout.

sara: customer ran a capture and attached two sample lines:
```
[2026-03-15T13:04:27Z] rq_3f8b2c GET /v1/generate 503 "proxy:shaper:burst_elevator" upstream_latency=1210ms conn=0/1024
[2026-03-15T13:04:28Z] rq_3f8b2d GET /v1/generate 200 upstream_latency=410ms conn=12/1024
```

matt: confirms. root cause looks like burst_elevator reacted to untagged metric causing autoscaler to under-provision. short-term mitigation: disable burst_elevator in usw2 or increase proxy pool cap. which is easier now?

infra-oncall: fastest is to bump node pool target + temporarily disable shaper on the affected route. applying shaper=false to route /v1/generate in usw2 now (will be a 30s config).

sara: pinging customer that we are applying mitigation and that we saw the shaper trigger. telling them we may see transient 503s for ~1-2m while changes roll.

support-bot: deploy: route-config-update started by infra-oncall (change_id rc-9876).

alex: good. after the change, can we get a smoke test from the customer with the same curl loop?

sara: customer ran loop again. error rate dropped to <1% within 40s of the change. they saw median latency back to ~430ms.

matt: follow-ups: 1) fix metric tag in autoscaler rollout, 2) add a tracer that correlates shaper triggers to rollout ids, 3) postmortem to doc. I'll file an EPIC.

infra-oncall: noted. creating PR to ensure region labels propagate (PR #4592). also will add an alert to detect when autoscaler tags mismatch.

alex: update customer thread: root cause = ingress shaper engaged due to autoscaler tagging regression. mitigation = disabled shaper + increased pool. ETA for full fix ~24-48h. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sara: leaving the customer with a summary and next steps. will follow up once PR merges.
